overrides.note: Owner turned on the 15% stop for main picks as a risk choice (about even on return, cuts the worst losses)

Owner asked Claude to judge holds from the trend study (Oct 7): main picks still ahead of the S&P at the end of their 60-day hold are kept, re-checked every day, up to 1 year; picks behind are sold on schedule. Backtest: -1.26%/yr -> -0.35%/yr vs the S&P (not worse before the last 3 years, +4%/yr in them); per pick, ahead at day 60 added +4.4% over days 60-250 (t 2.2).
